title: Connect pass payload
description: The payload of a connect pass, the exact JSON bytes the control plane signed. A connect pass is the payload in base64url without padding, a dot, and the signature in base64url without padding, at most 1024 characters with no white space; the signature is 64 bytes of Ed25519 under the control plane's server key over qory-connect-ed25519-v1, a line feed and the payload bytes. The control plane sends a person to the adapter's connect_url (adapter.schema.json) with the pass as the query parameter state. The adapter verifies the signature under a server key the adapter pinned at enrolment: after a server key rotation it tries each pinned key, and any one that verifies passes. It then reads the payload against this schema, checks that adapter_id is the id the adapter is enrolled as and that expires_at has not passed, refuses a nonce it has seen, and only then links the connection to the organisation of the adapter it is enrolled as. adapter_id names exactly one organisation, so the pass names no organisation itself. An adapter links a connection to an organisation only through a connect pass.

adapter_id.description: The adapter the pass is for, as the control plane enrolled it.

nonce.description: 128 random bits in base64url without padding, 22 characters, new for each pass.

expires_at.description: When the pass expires, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, at most 15 minutes after the control plane issued it.
